DEMO-0002.name: Noice Magnesium Glycinate
DEMO-0002.product_context:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Noice Magnesium Glycinate is an imaginary product made up for this demo. It is described as a daily health supplement that provides magnesium bound to the amino acid glycine.

FORMAT AND PACK
Capsule, supplied in a bottle of 60 capsules. Serving size is 2 capsules. Category: Health Supplement. Not for medicinal use.

DIETARY AND ALLERGEN INFORMATION
Vegetarian capsule shell. Gluten free.

DIRECTIONS FOR USE
Take 2 capsules daily after dinner, swallowed whole with water.
Do not exceed the recommended daily usage of 2 capsules.

STORAGE
Store in a cool, dry place below 30°C, away from direct sunlight.
Keep the bottle tightly closed and out of reach of children.

PRECAUTIONS
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, children, persons with a kidney condition and persons on medication should consult a doctor before use.
Not for medicinal use. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
If more than the recommended amount has been taken, or a child has swallowed capsules, contact a doctor or call 112 immediately.

NOT COVERED BY THIS BRIEF
Anything not written above. This product and its label are imaginary.

DEMO-0003.name: Noice Omega-3 Fish Oil
DEMO-0003.product_context:
PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Noice Omega-3 Fish Oil is an imaginary product made up for this demo. It is described as a daily health supplement that provides the omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA from fish oil.

FORMAT AND PACK
Softgel, supplied in a bottle of 60 softgels. Serving size is 1 softgel. Category: Health Supplement. Not for medicinal use.

DIETARY AND ALLERGEN INFORMATION
Contains fish. The softgel shell contains gelatin. Not suitable for vegetarians.

DIRECTIONS FOR USE
Take 1 softgel daily with a meal, swallowed whole with water.
Do not exceed the recommended daily usage of 1 softgel.

STORAGE
Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C, away from direct sunlight.
Keep the bottle tightly closed and out of reach of children.

PRECAUTIONS
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, children, persons on blood-thinning medicines and persons on any other medication should consult a doctor before use.
Do not use if allergic to fish.
Not for medicinal use. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
If more than the recommended amount has been taken, or a child has swallowed softgels, contact a doctor or call 112 immediately.

NOT COVERED BY THIS BRIEF
Anything not written above. This product and its label are imaginary.
